**The method.** The 1,260 QuantLib 1.44 units nanoql ports, wholly or in part, hold 1,949 classes, read from each unit's header outside its detail namespace. nanoql has a type of the same name for 1,885 of them; 17 under another name (an interface's "I", QuantLib's Impl merged into its type, a case change); and 47 inside their unit's files, where the class is an implementation detail. QLNet 1.13.2 declares a type of the same name for 1,017 of the 1,949 (52%). A type of the same name isn't proof of the same API.
